name: cm6build
description: Build the vendored CodeMirror 6 bundle for mobile_lite (see build.bat)

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/*! CodeMirror 6 (MIT, https://codemirror.net) - vendored ES module bundle for mobile_lite. Rebuild: mobile_lite/vendor/cm6build/build.bat */" --outfile=../codemirror6.js
